subject: HorizonMed - provisioning trace, SAML samples, and admin activation export
messages:
From: Amir Patel <amir.patel@horizonmed.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: srs-security@horizonmed.com
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: provisioning trace + SAML assertion samples + admin activation export

Hi Jordan,

We're preparing for an upcoming SIG review and need a small bundle of artifacts to validate HorizonMed's access posture while we evaluate Redwood for a pilot. Can you confirm whether you can provide the following by EOD Friday 6/18?

- SCIM delta snapshot covering the last 30 days (schema + sample payloads)
- SAML assertion samples for a few user login flows (including NameID formats and attributes)
- Admin activation / role elevation audit (CSV export) for the past 90 days
- A short justification template we can use for any privileged service accounts

If any of this is sensitive, tell us what redaction or delivery channel you prefer (encrypted Drive link / secure upload). Also include an ETA and any constraints (rate limits, export size).

Thanks — Amir
Amir Patel
Security Engineer, HorizonMed
srs-security@horizonmed.com

(Attachment: none)
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Amir Patel <amir.patel@horizonmed.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: provisioning trace + SAML assertion samples + admin activation export

Thanks for the clear list, Amir — we can deliver these artifacts. Quick notes and proposed timeline: 

- SCIM delta snapshot: we can export a 30-day delta as a JSON bundle (anonymized tenant ids where applicable). ETA: Wed 6/16 EOD.
- SAML assertion samples: we will provide a handful of sampled assertions (redacted where necessary) covering interactive SSO and a service-to-service assertion for a service account. ETA: Thu 6/17.
- Admin activation / role elevation audit: we can produce a CSV with activation timestamps, actor, target account/role, and justification where present. ETA: Thu 6/17.
- Privileged service account justification template: we have a template we can share immediately.

Delivery channel: we propose an encrypted Drive folder (shared via DLP-enabled link). If you need a different channel we can do DocuSign/secure FTP for signed artifacts.

I'll coordinate the exports with Sean (provisioning logs) and Laura (access governance). Deliverable list and a short mutual action plan will go in my follow-up.

Jordan Blake
Sr. Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
--

Looping in a couple of clarifying items for HorizonMed: 

1) Retention and redaction: for SCIM deltas we will remove PII fields by default (email hashed where requested). Confirm if you need raw values for identity mapping.
2) SAML samples: we'll include full Assertion XML for 3 example flows; note that we will redact persistent identifiers unless you provide a signed NDA/secure channel confirmation.
3) Service account proof: our recommended justification fields are in the attached template — please use it for any privileged account justification you ask us to surface.

Attachment: privilege-justification-template.xlsx (stub)

If Amir confirms NDA/secure channel, Sean and I will proceed with the CSV and the SCIM export.

Laura Bennett
Security & Compliance Program Manager, Redwood Inference

> > Thanks for the clear list, Amir — we can deliver these artifacts...
From: Amir Patel <amir.patel@horizonmed.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: srs-security@horizonmed.com
Date: Wed, 16 Jun 2027 10:17:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: provisioning trace + SAML assertion samples + admin activation export

Thanks Jordan and Laura — that timeline works for us. A couple of clarifications from our SIG coordinator: 

- For the SAML assertions we need examples that show both email and persistent NameID variants. If redaction is needed, include a mapping file (hashed->raw) in a separately protected channel.
- Retention: confirm the SCIM delta includes add/modify/delete operations with timestamps (the SIG reviewer will sample the delta sync logic).
- Admin activation CSV: please include whether a role elevation was manual or automated and the policy reference id if available.

We're happy to accept an encrypted Drive link. We'll also attach our completed SIG questionnaire for context.

Attachment: SIG-questionnaire-v2.xlsx (stub)

—Amir
Amir Patel
Security Engineer, HorizonMed

Amir — closing the loop here. Deliverables (zipped, encrypted Drive share):

1) scim-delta-snapshot-20270614.json — 30-day delta, operations (add/modify/delete) with timestamps. (Attachment: scim-delta-snapshot-20270614.json)
2) saml-assertion-samples.txt — three sampled assertions (interactive/email NameID, persistent NameID, service-account assertion). Sensitive identifiers hashed; mapping file available on request under NDA. (Attachment: saml-assertion-samples.txt)
3) admin-activation-log-sample.csv — 90-day export (actor, target_role, method=[manual|automated], policy_ref). (Attachment: admin-activation-log-sample.csv)
4) privilege-justification-template.xlsx — as requested. (Attachment: privilege-justification-template.xlsx)

Links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cHorizonMedEvidence (shared, access audited)
HubSpot: https://hubspot.com/deal/98765

Next steps: Amir, confirm receipt and tell us if you want the mapping file; if so we'll prepare a short NDA/secure transfer and then share the mapping and unredacted samples. If everything looks good we'll mark the ticket as delivered and put this on a weekly cadence for any further exports.

Thanks — Jordan
Jordan Blake
Sr. Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0182
